statusMeaning: Families define the full scope. Progress records verified subsets only; presence of an upstream test file is not native acceptance evidence.

progress.managedFoundation: Numeric and timeline shared playback, reactive ownership, spring playback, numeric/grid/automatic/randomized/typed-unit staggering, nested timelines/callbacks, scalar replace property/set tracks, typed CSS custom-property playback and standalone timers;557 unfiltered tests pass normal Release and Traced Debug on the current Windows host.
progress.playbackTiming: Timing geometry matches55 cases/929 samples; callback/control state matches51 traces and scheduled Timer matches18 admitted-frame traces. NumericAnimation matches46 value/callback/state traces (24 generated), plus three interruption tests. Public Timeline now shares the clock. Full normal/Traced suites pass557/557. Earlier source passes both strict NativeAOT publishes and PE executions with public Core/DOM56/CSS2, private View/runtime; new timeline code has fresh Traced JIT host evidence and still needs PE replay. Timer tracks, full per-child callbacks, broader nested repeated controllers, global engine arbitration and final scoped review remain incomplete.
progress.timelinePlayback: 33 source traces capture root/child states, values and all callback phases. Thirty root-clock comparisons replay recorded child completion aggregates; six further phase/interruption tests pass. Twenty-one public Timeline comparisons exercise actual property/set writes, root state/callback observations, call tracks, repeats/alternate/reverse, signed delay/gaps, skipped loops, zero call tracks and scheduled speed/control changes. Eight lifetime/authoring tests pass. Added timers, per-child callbacks and broader borrowed-controller cases remain open.
progress.easing: 46 default named easings plus one Bezier and two step-mode fixtures match 441 upstream samples; runner consumes custom easing with tested reentrant cancellation and seek. Full easing parameter domains, irregular and multi-stop linear remain incomplete.
progress.springs: Physical/perceived spring modes, parameter clamps/mutations, perceived completion and settling-duration playback compare against twelve constructor and six mutation snapshots. Whole-millisecond perceived input accepts uint; precise fractional input remains supported.
progress.staggering: 67 numeric/geometry/random fixtures,7 unit fixtures and7 timeline-position fixtures cover step/range, origins, explicit and automatic 2D/3D geometry, axes, reversal, easing, start, modifiers, total overrides, index mapping, random origins, seeded jitter and checked typed CSS output. Existing DOMPointInit and Element APIs support measured positions; recording-interface tests verify centers and measurement counts. Actual native layout/unit integration and string-label stagger starts remain incomplete.
progress.timelines: 29 position cases,3 synchronized-child traces,7 stagger cases,6 callback traces,2 nested-controller traces,56 scalar schedules (32 generated) and21 shared-playback comparisons pass. Scalar replace/set composition, root repeats/directions/speed, callback suppression/reset, cycle rejection, ancestor guards and actual Ranvier ownership are covered. Timer tracks, full per-child and broader borrowed-controller playback, additive/blend/global composition, keyframes, removal, stretch/refresh/revert and promises remain incomplete.
progress.nativeIntegration: Archived public Core/DOM56/CSS2 normal/Traced strict NativeAOT PEs pass with private View625b and owned ABI62 runtime; schema3 binds337 source inputs,190 compiler inputs and nine files per mode. Exact six-package identities are retained. New timeline source passes a fresh Traced public-Core JIT build/run, including repeat/alternate native style/layout output, owner disposal during before-update and host.Errors=0; it still needs current-source PE replay. Portable suites557/557 pass in both configurations. Public View publisher prerequisites are running per coordinator; no public View or consumed-public-native claim yet. Broad coverage, host destruction, GPU and matched full public acceptance remain open.
